name: remove_asks
title: Removing a row the person entered asks on a card, and goes only on the yes

steps.reply:
I've set up a **Food log** in a new Food module. It's empty so far. Each entry holds the food, when you ate it, the meal, the quantity, calories, protein, carbs, fat and notes.

To log something, tell me in plain words, like "two boiled eggs and toast for breakfast". I'll look up the calories and macros from a source I can name when the food is a known product. For home-cooked portions I'll estimate and mark them as estimates. If you don't give a time, I'll assume you ate it just now.

What did you eat today? I can log it now.

I logged 2 eggs: 143 kcal, 12.6 g protein, 0.7 g carbs and 9.5 g fat.

The numbers are USDA reference values for a large whole egg, doubled. I recalled them rather than fetching the page, so I can look them up and confirm if you want.

I assumed these, since you didn't say:
- **Size:** large eggs.
- **Time and meal:** eaten now (22:10) and logged as a Snack.
- **Cooking:** no added oil or butter.

If you fried them in butter, or this was dinner, tell me and I'll fix the entry.

steps.say: remove the eggs from the log
steps.reply: I removed the 2 eggs from your food log, so it's empty again.
